Swims at land speed. Illusions 3 times a day. Head-water spilled: no Reduction, every Ring and Trait 1 for a day.
Takes no harm from arrows other than armor-piercing ones. Immune to two spells, which vary from oni to oni.

Immune to effects on the mind or emotions. A Called Shot to the head dealing 18+ Wounds destroys it.
